Spec: Overview shows work in progress — UI atlas

Spec: Overview shows work in progress — UI atlas

7 views with 35 states. Mocked: Overview tab, Placement options. The remaining areas are listed from the map and are not designed yet.

Illustrative only. Low-fi wireframes on the app’s tokens: they decide anatomy, states and copy intent, not the final look. All names and data are fictional. Card text is rendered from the cards files and the view list from spec-overview-in-progress-ui-map.md: change the markdown and regenerate. Link to a view or a state by id: #A1, #A1-s2.

Compared with today’s app

Paseo FSH fork fsh at b245e51ae (2026-11-24), Overview as approved in spec-overview-tree.

Where in-progress work shows today, none of it on Overview:

  • Sidebar row: a spinning ring while the workspace counts as running (an agent turn, subagents, monitors, background shells). No count, no names.
  • Agent tabs strip: a ring on an agent's icon while its turn runs.
  • Composer bar of one agent: subagents pill ("3 working", "1 failed", "2 ready to review"), status pill ("working · 8h", "· stale" after 2 turns), Asks pill (open asks only, hidden at 0).
  • Explorer tabs: Status (cards, "N turns since"), Asks ("Needs you" and "In progress" sections), Lineage (agents with a ring while running).
  • Overview: Status shows the card's word ("Working") with no age; Your move shows only what waits on you, plus "Archive waits for background work" once the work shipped; Tree shows child workspaces' state words and "· N agents" on this workspace's row. A running agent, subagents, background shells and in-progress asks appear nowhere.

5 new, 2 changed views. Inside frames, while Changes is on: new changed removed (removed parts show only then).

Decisions (stage 1, 2026-11-25)

  1. In progress lists all four kinds: agents with a running turn, their subagents, background work an idle agent left running, and asks in progress (A5).
  2. Grouped: one row per agent and per ask; each agent's subagents and background work fold under it as counted lines (A6).
  3. Placement: its own "In progress" section directly after Your move (V1). V2 and V3 are dropped; O4 takes V1's anatomy (A4).
  4. An in-progress ask says what it waits on: PR facts from paseo-asks for PR asks ("CI running", "review requested"), a one-line "waits on" the agent sets when it takes any other ask; with neither, its age only (A7).
  5. An in-progress ask with nothing moving it (no running turn of its agent, no live background job, no watched open PR) is flagged on its row in the warning tone, "nothing moving"; Overview only for now (A8).
  6. Status shows the card's age, and a warning line "Nothing is running in this workspace" when the card says Working and no agent turn, subagent or background job is live (A9).
  7. In-progress ask rows get two actions when expanded (O5): "Take it back" reopens the ask for you with its buttons, "Remind agent" tells the owner to update it. Agent, subagent and background rows only open what they name (A10).
  8. Archive waits while any ask is in progress, as it waits for background work; the "Archive waits for background work" row goes, since In progress names that work (A11).
  9. Stage 1 approved (A12).

Overview tab — area rules

source: spec-overview-in-progress-ui-overview.md

Area-wide

  • Who. The operator, running 10–30 agent workspaces; agents take asks on, run subagents and leave background jobs (merge queues, watchers, dev servers) running.
  • Device. Desktop: Overview tab in the Explorer sidebar, ~360–480 px wide. Mobile: the workspace sheet, full width. Same content, same order.
  • Rows. As in the approved Overview: one line per row, a name, a muted facts word, a chevron when it opens something. Tones as the app's state words: running accent, waiting warning, blocked/failed danger, done success, idle muted.
  • Live. Rows appear, change and leave in place as turns start and end, jobs stop and asks move; no refresh control.
  • Buttons. Your move keeps its buttons. In progress has buttons only inside an expanded ask (O5).
  • Permissions. None beyond opening the workspace.

Decisions (cards, 2026-11-25)

  1. In progress rows go oldest first across all kinds (A13).
  2. Five rows show, then "Show all (N)" (A14).
  3. One open row for the whole tab across Your move and In progress; a Your move ask you started replying to stays open (A15).
  4. Take it back acts at once, with no confirmation; the row moving into Your move is the feedback (A16).
  5. No placeholder row in Your move while Archive waits; In progress below is the explanation (A17).
  6. The "Nothing is running" warning covers Working cards only (A18).
  7. An ask whose PR merged while in progress reads "merged · waiting on the agent", muted; it turns into "nothing moving" in the warning tone after 10 minutes with no turn running (A19).
  8. Stage 2 approved (A20).
  9. Times on In progress rows mean "since it last changed", as everywhere else on Overview: ask since its last update, agent since its last activity, background job since it started; rows sort by that time (A21).

O4 In progress

newP17 states · Explorer panel · 420 (mobile sheet · 390)card text: spec-overview-in-progress-ui-overview.md

Short

What is moving in this workspace without you: agents, their subagents and background work, and asks the agent has taken on.

Change

New.

Extended

A section directly after Your move, hidden when nothing is in progress. One row per agent that has a running turn, subagents running or background work, and one row per ask in progress (A5, A6). Under an agent row, its subagents fold into one indented line ("↳ 6 subagents · 2 working") and each background job into its own indented line ("↳ merge-queue.sh · running 2h"). An ask row shows its title, what it waits on and its age; PR asks take the word from the PR ("CI running", "review requested", "merged"), other asks the agent's own "waits on" line, otherwise only the age (A7). An ask that nothing moves (no running turn of its agent, no live background job, no watched open PR) shows "nothing moving" in the warning tone (A8). Every time on a row means "since it last changed", as in Your move, Status and the sidebar: an ask since its last update, an agent since its last activity, a background job since it started (A21). Order: oldest first by that time, across all kinds, so what moved least recently comes first (A13, A21). Five rows show, then "Show all (N)".

Get here

Overview tab, after Your move.

Shows

Section label "In progress" with the row count; agent rows ("Billing track lead · working · 3m"), indented subagent and background lines, ask rows ("PR #2104 — invoices list · CI running · 20m").

Scenarios

Coming back to a track lead after lunch: "In progress · 4", one agent working with two subagents, three PR asks on CI; nothing to do. Opening a workspace that looks finished: Status says Working 8h ago, In progress lists five asks, two "nothing moving"; expand one and take it back.

Variants

Busy (agent, subagents, shell, asks); stuck (only asks, two nothing moving); idle agent with a background job only; more than five rows (Show all); nothing in progress (section absent); mobile sheet of stuck.

Edge cases

An agent row opens its tab; a subagent line opens that agent's subagents popover; a background line opens the owning agent's tab. Archiving an agent ends its background jobs (the daemon closes its session), so its rows leave the section with it. An ask whose PR merged while in progress → "merged · waiting on the agent", in the warning tone once 10 minutes pass with nothing moving.

O5 In-progress ask

newP1expanded row on O45 states · Explorer panel · 420 (mobile sheet · 390)card text: spec-overview-in-progress-ui-overview.md

Short

One in-progress ask opened in place: what it is, what it waits on, and a way to take it back.

Change

New.

Extended

Pressing an ask row expands it in place, like an open Your move row; one row is open at a time across Your move and In progress. It shows the ask's body (rendered markdown, first lines, then "More"), a facts line ("Waits on CI for #2104 · taken 20m ago · last moved 5m ago"), its links, and three actions (A10): Take it back sets the ask open and moves it to Your move with its own buttons; the agent is told. Remind agent asks the owner to update the ask or hand it back; the row says "Reminded just now" until the agent updates it. Show in chat opens the agent at the ask.

Get here

An ask row in O4.

Shows

The expanded row: title, body, facts line, links, the three actions as quiet buttons.

Variants

PR ask waiting on CI; ask with nothing moving (warning facts line); just reminded; after Take it back (the row leaves In progress and opens in Your move).

Edge cases

The owner agent is archived → Remind agent is absent and the facts line says "agent archived"; Take it back still works. The ask changes while open (the agent resolves it) → the row collapses and leaves with the section's normal update.

E2 Status

changedP17 states · Explorer panel · 420 (mobile sheet · 390)card text: spec-overview-in-progress-ui-overview.md

Short

The status card now says how old it is and warns when it claims work that nothing is doing.

Change

Changed — the card's age is new next to the state word; a warning line is new when the card says Working and nothing runs.

Extended

The state word reads "Working · updated 8h ago" (A9). When the card says Working and the workspace has no running agent turn, subagent or background job, a warning line under the summary reads "Nothing is running in this workspace." The existing "You replied 4m ago; the agent hasn't updated this since." line stays and shows above the warning when both apply.

Get here

Overview tab, under the title.

Shows

State pill, "· updated 8h ago", summary, the warning line in the warning tone.

Variants

Fresh working card (age only); stale working card with nothing running (warning); working card with only a background job live (age only, no warning); done card (age only).

Edge cases

No status card → nothing changes: the state word comes from the agents, with no age. A card updated under a minute ago reads "updated just now".

Placement options — area rules

source: spec-overview-in-progress-ui-placement.md

Area-wide

  • Purpose. Compare three placements of in-progress work for A4. Every option is drawn on the same three workspaces, in the same order, so frames with the same state id compare directly.
  • Workspaces. Busy: the agent's turn runs, it has 6 subagents (2 working), a background shell, 3 asks in progress and 1 ask waiting on you. Stuck: the turn ended 8 hours ago, the status card still says Working, nothing runs, 5 asks are in progress (3 wait on CI, 2 have nothing moving them). Nothing in progress: one ask waits on you, nothing else moves.
  • Device. Desktop: Overview tab in the Explorer sidebar, ~420 px wide. Mobile: the workspace sheet, 390 px. Same content, same order.
  • Rows. As in the approved Overview: one line per row, a name, a muted facts word, a chevron when it opens something. Tones as the app's state words: running accent, waiting warning, blocked/failed danger, done success, idle muted.
  • Buttons. Only Your move has buttons, in every option.
  • Permissions. None beyond opening the workspace.
